description: This Kotlin source file defines composable functions for managing draggable scrollbars in lazy layouts such as lists and grids within a Jetpack Compose UI. It includes functions to remember and handle thumb position displacements for different lazy layout states and a generic function to trigger scrolling based on thumb position percentage.

methods.name: LazyListState.rememberDraggableScroller
methods.description: Creates a draggable scroller function for a LazyListState, reacting to thumb position displacements.

methods.name: LazyGridState.rememberDraggableScroller
methods.description: Creates a draggable scroller function for a LazyGridState, reacting to thumb position displacements.

methods.name: LazyStaggeredGridState.rememberDraggableScroller
methods.description: Creates a draggable scroller function for a LazyStaggeredGridState, reacting to thumb position displacements.
